metadata.source: Directorate of Economics and Statistics (DES), Dept. of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, data.desagri.gov.in -- same real district-wise crop APY records already in dashboard/data/crop_stats_des_by_district/, re-aggregated here, no new fetch.
metadata.method: Deterministic OLS trend (numpy.polyfit, degree 1) on each crop+season's real yield_per_ha history across all available DES years -- NOT a satellite/ML prediction (docs/CROP_YIELD_METHODOLOGY.md's literature-grounded parcel-level model remains blocked on ground truth, see its §7). next_year_yield_indicative is the trend line's value one year past the last real DES year; _lo95/_hi95 is a 95% band from the real residual standard deviation, no random noise injected. Minimum 5 real years required per crop+season or it is omitted.
metadata.data_quality: Indicative trend derived from verified-official real history -- not independently validated against a held-out year, not a substitute for an official crop forecast.
